**New:** drag the bubble with the right mouse button to just move it, even over an app, without giving that app a mini (a right-click that doesn't move still opens the menu). Also recent: the bubble stays at its spot when an app gets a mini, and hiding a mini no longer makes it vanish for a moment.

**Windows:** download **Quicky_*_x64-setup.exe** and run it. No admin rights needed. Windows may show "Windows protected your PC" because the installer isn't code-signed yet: click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

**macOS** (11 or newer, Apple silicon and Intel): download **Quicky_*_universal.dmg**, open it and drag Quicky into Applications. The first time you open it, macOS says it can't check Quicky for malware, because Quicky isn't notarized by Apple: open **System Settings**, **Privacy & Security**, and click **Open Anyway** next to Quicky.

**Linux** (x86-64): download the **.AppImage**, make it executable and run it, or install the **.deb**. Minis inside other apps work with apps that run on X11.

Already have Quicky? It updates itself (Settings, Updates).
